title: Using DeepSpeed and Megatron to Train Megatron-Turing NLG 530B, A Large-Scale Generative Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating probabilities of male versus female identifiers across 323 occupations using fill-in-the-blank templates, and analyzing the top 100 most frequent adjectives co-occurring with male and female identifiers in generated text.

Analyzing the frequency of adjectives co-occurring with ethnic identifiers (Asian, Black, White) in generated text, and conducting sentiment analysis using SentiWordNet to measure positive and negative sentiment scores for each ethnicity.
Analyzing the most frequent distinct adjectives that co-occur with prompts mentioning religious practitioners across six categories (Atheism, Buddhism, Christianity, Hinduism, Islam, Judaism).
